```
module collections.merging
  purpose: Merge sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.

public function merge_sorted(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list in which every value appears once.
  tags: lists, sorting, integers
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 5, 6]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 1, 2], right: [2, 2, 3]) is [1, 2, 3]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: [4, 5]) is [4, 5]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: []) is []

  let combined be left.append_all(right)
  return combined.distinct().sorted()
end

test "merging two empty lists gives an empty list"
  check merge_sorted(left: [], right: []) is []
end

test "merging overlapping lists removes duplicates"
  check merge_sorted(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 5, 6]
end
```

```
module library.merging
  purpose: Combine sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list.

public function merge_sorted(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  tags: lists, sorting
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 5, 6]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 1, 2], right: [2, 2, 3]) is [1, 2, 3]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: [4, 7]) is [4, 7]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: []) is []

  let combined be left.append_all(right)
  return combined.distinct().sorted()
end

test "merging two empty lists gives an empty list"
  let empty: List of Integer be []
  let merged be merge_sorted(left: empty, right: empty)
  check merged.is_empty() is true
  check merged.length() is 0
end
```

```
module library.merging
  purpose: Combine sorted lists of Integers.

public function merge_sorted(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  tags: lists, sorting
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 5, 6]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [1, 1, 2], right: [2, 2, 3]) is [1, 2, 3]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: [4, 7]) is [4, 7]
  example: merge_sorted(left: [], right: []) is []

  let combined be left.append_all(right)
  let ordered be combined.sorted()
  return ordered.distinct()
end
```
